Trigger.name: !MAP Data Parser
Trigger.script: deleteLine() elro.onRoom( tonumber(matches[2]), tonumber(matches[3]), matches[4], matches[5], matches[6], matches[7], matches[8])

Alias.name: mapsrc
Alias.script:
local p = (matches[2] or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if p == "" then cecho("
<cyan>[elro] src_dir = <reset>" .. tostring(elro.src_dir) .. "
") else elro.src_dir = p local f = io.open(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/elro_src.txt", "w") if f then f:write(p .. "
") f:close() end cecho("
<green>[elro] src_dir set + persisted: <reset>" .. p .. "
<yellow>run 'mapreload' to re-source.
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapdump
Alias.script: local a = matches[2] if a == "sel" then elro.dumpsel() elseif a == "all" then elro.dumpall() else elro.dump() end

Alias.name: maprelayout_all
Alias.script:
-- flush() hands off to the background coroutine when mapbg is on, so the -- completion notice comes from the driver (relayout_done); saying "done" here -- would be a lie about work that has not started yet. if elro.flush() ~= -1 then cecho("
<green>[elro]: full relayout done.
<reset>") else cecho("
<cyan>[elro]: full relayout running in the background -- keep playing.
<reset>") end

Alias.name: maprelayout_this
Alias.script: -- Force a relayout of the CURRENT canvas, whether or not anything changed. -- `maprelayout` is incremental (dirty maps only) and `maprelayout all` does every -- map; this is the "redo THIS one now" that `mapengine eqw` used to provide as a -- side effect of setting the engine. Same two-line body it had: mark dirty, flush. elro.relayout_this()

Alias.name: mapwd
Alias.script: local a = matches[2] local function say(t) cecho("\n<yellow>[elro] " .. t .. "<reset>\n") end if a == "off" then elro.walkWatchdog = false ; say("walk watchdog OFF -- a runaway relayout will freeze Mudlet.") elseif a then elro.walkWatchdog = tonumber(a) ; say("walk watchdog: " .. tostring(elro.walkWatchdog) .. "s of ENGINE time (idle excluded).") else say("walk watchdog: " .. (elro.walkWatchdog == false and "off" or tostring(elro.walkWatchdog or 60) .. "s")) end

Alias.name: mapknobs
Alias.script: if matches[2] == "reset" then elro.reset_knobs() else elro.knob_list() end

Alias.name: maprelayout
Alias.script:
elro.tr("maprelayout: alias fired") -- NOTE the pcall is on the LAUNCH only. With background mode on, flush_dirty -- creates the coroutine and returns immediately; every resume happens later from -- bg_step's timer, so this pcall is never on the coroutine's stack. That matters: -- Mudlet is stock Lua 5.1 and cannot yield across a C-call boundary. local ok, n = pcall(elro.flush_dirty) if not ok then cecho("
<red>[elro] flush_dirty ERROR: " .. tostring(n) .. "
<reset>") elseif n == -1 then if elro.bg_busy() then cecho("
<cyan>[elro]: relaying out in the background -- keep playing.
<reset>") end elseif n == 0 then cecho("
<green>[elro]: nothing changed; nothing to relayout.
<reset>") else cecho("
<green>[elro]: relayed " .. tostring(n) .. " map(s).
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapauto
Alias.script:
local a, n = matches[2], tonumber(matches[3] or "") if a == "idle" then if n and n >= 1 then elro.autoIdle = n end cecho("
<green>[elro]: auto-relayout fires after " .. elro.autoIdle .. "s of standing still (it waits for a pause on purpose -- a relayout started
" .. "mid-walk has its input invalidated by your next step and is discarded).
<reset>") else elro.autoflush = (a == "on") cecho("
<green>[elro]: auto-relayout = " .. tostring(elro.autoflush) .. (elro.autoflush and (" (after " .. elro.autoIdle .. "s idle, in the background)") or " (use maprelayout by hand)") .. "
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapbg
Alias.script:
local a = (matches[2] or ""):lower() local n = tonumber(matches[3] or "") if a == "" then elro.bg_status() elseif a == "cancel" then elro.bg_cancel() elseif a == "slice" and n and n >= 5 then elro.bgSlice = n cecho("
<green>[elro]: background slice = " .. n .. "ms per frame
<reset>") elseif a == "gc" then elro.bgGC = n or 0 cecho("
<green>[elro]: gc-in-the-gap = " .. elro.bgGC .. (elro.bgGC > 0 and " (collects between frames; the profile reports gc ms -- set it back to 0 if the worst frame does not move)" or " (off: Lua collects on its own schedule)") .. "
<reset>") elseif a == "hook" then elro.bgHook = n or 0 cecho("
<green>[elro]: overrun hook = " .. elro.bgHook .. (elro.bgHook > 0 and (" VM instructions between probes -- the profile will name the SOURCE LINES" .. " that ran past the frame budget. Diagnostic only; set back to 0 when done.") or " (off)") .. "
<reset>") else elro.bgLayout = (a == "on") cecho("
<green>[elro]: background relayout = " .. tostring(elro.bgLayout) .. (elro.bgLayout and "" or " (relayouts will freeze the client again)") .. "
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapcs
Alias.script: if (matches[2] or "") == "reset" then elro.cs_reset() cecho("\n<green>[elro]: c-space snapshot cleared; the next relayout re-reads Mudlet.\n<reset>") end elro.cs_stats()

Alias.name: mapmerge
Alias.script:
local src = matches[2] if elro.merge == nil then elro.load_merge() end local cur = elro.current and getRoomArea(elro.current) local into = cur and elro.areaName(cur) if not into then cecho("
<red>[elro]: can't tell which area you're in; move once first.
<reset>") elseif src == into then cecho("
<red>[elro]: can't merge an area into itself.
<reset>") else elro.merge[src] = into elro.save_merge() -- Do NOT relayout here: a merge only changes membership, and rebuilding a big merged -- area is expensive. Just mark the two involved areas dirty (only ones that already have -- a tab -- avoid creating a stray via addAreaName); the redirect takes effect when -- recompute_areas next runs (e.g. via a manual 'maprelayout this' / 'maprelayout'), which -- also re-derives dirty for any area it misses here. local areas = getAreaTable() or {} if areas[src] then elro.dirty[areas[src]] = true end if areas[into] then elro.dirty[areas[into]] = true end cecho("
<green>[elro]: merged '" .. src .. "' into '" .. into .. "' (marked dirty; run 'maprelayout this' to rebuild).
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapunmerge
Alias.script:
local src = matches[2] if elro.merge == nil then elro.load_merge() end if elro.merge[src] then local into = elro.merge[src] -- the target it was merged into elro.merge[src] = nil elro.save_merge() -- Same as mapmerge: defer the rebuild. Mark the target dirty (only if it has a tab -- the -- src area re-appears when recompute_areas next runs, and it dirties both then) and let the -- user trigger the relayout manually. local areas = getAreaTable() or {} if areas[into] then elro.dirty[areas[into]] = true end cecho("
<green>[elro]: unmerged '" .. src .. "' (marked dirty; run 'maprelayout this' to rebuild).
<reset>") else cecho("
<red>[elro]: no merge recorded for '" .. src .. "'.
<reset>") end

Alias.name: mapfold
Alias.script:
local dir = elro.norm(matches[2]) if not elro.current then cecho("
<red>[elro]: current room unknown; move once first.
<reset>") else local set, dest = elro.fold_branch(elro.current, dir) if not set then cecho("
<red>[elro]: no '" .. dir .. "' exit from here.
<reset>") else local name = elro.fold_name(elro.current, dir) local n = 0 for id in pairs(set) do setRoomUserData(id, "fold", name) ; n = n + 1 end cecho("
<green>[elro]: folded " .. n .. " rooms (" .. dir .. ") into '" .. name .. "'.
<reset>") elro.flush() end end

Alias.name: mapunfold
Alias.script:
local dir = elro.norm(matches[2]) if not elro.current then cecho("
<red>[elro]: current room unknown; move once first.
<reset>") else local name = elro.fold_name(elro.current, dir) local n = 0 for id in pairs(getRooms() or {}) do if getRoomUserData(id, "fold") == name then setRoomUserData(id, "fold", "") ; n = n + 1 end end if n > 0 then cecho("
<green>[elro]: unfolded " .. n .. " rooms from '" .. name .. "'.
<reset>") elro.flush() else cecho("
<red>[elro]: no fold '" .. name .. "' to undo.
<reset>") end end

Alias.name: mapfolds
Alias.script:
local counts = {} for id in pairs(getRooms() or {}) do local f = getRoomUserData(id, "fold") if f and f ~= "" then counts[f] = (counts[f] or 0) + 1 end end local any = false cecho("
<cyan>[elro] folds:<reset>") for name, c in pairs(counts) do cecho("
<cyan> " .. name .. " (" .. c .. " rooms)<reset>") ; any = true end if not any then cecho("
<cyan> (none)<reset>") end cecho("
")

Alias.name: mapmerges
Alias.script:
if elro.merge == nil then elro.load_merge() end local any = false cecho("
<cyan>[elro] area merges:<reset>") for a, b in pairs(elro.merge) do cecho("
<cyan> " .. a .. " -> " .. b .. "<reset>") ; any = true end if not any then cecho("
<cyan> (none)<reset>") end cecho("
")

Alias.name: mapsteals
Alias.script:
local any = false cecho("
<cyan>[elro] stolen rooms:<reset>") for id in pairs(getRooms() or {}) do local a = getRoomUserData(id, "adopt") if a and a ~= "" then cecho("
<cyan> " .. id .. " (" .. (getRoomName(id) or "?") .. ") -> " .. a .. "<reset>") any = true end end if not any then cecho("
<cyan> (none)<reset>") end cecho("
")

Script.name: elro core
Script.script:
-- ElrohirMapper bootstrap loader. -- The mapper's Lua now lives in external source files (lua/core.lua, -- lua/layout.lua) so the bulk of the code is editable as real Lua instead of -- XML-entity-escaped script blobs. This script only resolves the source -- directory and dofile()s the modules; "mapreload" re-sources without a -- package reinstall. -- -- Source directory (elro.src_dir) resolution, in order: -- 1. an already-set elro.src_dir (set it before install to override) -- 2. a path written into <mudletHomeDir>/elro_src.txt (first line) -- 3. the installed package's own lua/ directory -- this is the SHIPPED path -- 4. the dev repo default below elro = elro or {} if not elro.src_dir then local ok, f = pcall(io.open, getMudletHomeDir() .. "/elro_src.txt", "r") if ok and f then local p = f:read("*l"); f:close() if p then p = p:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end if p and p ~= "" then elro.src_dir = p end end end if not elro.src_dir then -- Mudlet unpacks a package into <profile>/<mpackage>/, so an installed copy -- carries its own lua/. Probed by reading modules.lua rather than assumed, so a -- source checkout that was never installed falls through to the dev path below. local d = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/ElrohirMapper/lua" local ok, f = pcall(io.open, d .. "/modules.lua", "r") if ok and f then f:close() ; elro.src_dir = d end end elro.src_dir = elro.src_dir or "c:/mud/onserver/area/map_helper/client/lua"
-- The ordered module list lives in lua/modules.lua and is re-read on every load, so -- adding a module needs only `mapreload`, not a package reinstall. The literal list -- below is the fallback if that file cannot be read. -- Keep in sync with lua/modules.lua: a short list here loads a client missing whole -- engines (eqw/eqlevers/place) rather than failing, which misbehaves instead of erroring. elro.modules = { "geom.lua", "keys.lua", "core.lua", "tune.lua", "canvas.lua", "audit.lua", "topo.lua", "levers.lua", "eqw.lua", "eqlevers.lua", "place.lua", "walk.lua", "render.lua", "vert.lua" } function elro.load_modules() local ok, list = pcall(dofile, elro.src_dir .. "/modules.lua") if ok and type(list) == "table" then elro.modules = list end for _, m in ipairs(elro.modules) do local path = elro.src_dir .. "/" .. m local ok, err = pcall(dofile, path) if ok then cecho("
<green>[elro] loaded <reset>" .. path .. "
") else cecho("
<red>[elro] FAILED to load " .. path .. ":<reset> " .. tostring(err) .. "
") end end end
elro.load_modules()

Script.name: elro layout
Script.script: -- ElrohirMapper layout engine: externalized to lua/layout.lua and loaded by -- the bootstrap in the "elro core" script. This script body is intentionally -- empty so a package reinstall does not run stale embedded code.
